MapMatchingRequest(List<Location>?, string?, ShapeMatch, CostingModel, bool, DirectionsOptions?, TraceOptions?, int?, List<int>?, TraceAttributesFilter?)

The structure for the Map Matching request.

public MapMatchingRequest(List<Location>? shape = null, string? encodedPolyline = null, ShapeMatch shapeMatch = ShapeMatch.WalkOrSnap, CostingModel costing = CostingModel.Auto, bool useTimestamps = false, DirectionsOptions? directionsOptions = null, TraceOptions? traceOptions = null, int? beginTime = null, List<int>? durations = null, TraceAttributesFilter? filters = null)

Parameters

shape List<Location>

The shape to match

encodedPolyline string

The polyline to match

shapeMatch ShapeMatch

Allows some control of the matching algorithm based on the type of input.

costing CostingModel

Valhalla Map Matching can use any costing model available in the Valhalla route service

useTimestamps bool

A boolean value indicating whether the input timestamps or durations should be used when computing elapsed time at each edge along the matched path. If true, timestamps are used. If false (default), internal costing is applied to compute elapsed times.

directionsOptions DirectionsOptions

Specify units, language, and whether or not to return directions in a narrative form.

traceOptions TraceOptions

Trace options to improve results

beginTime int?

Begin timestamp for the trace. This is used along with the durations so that timestamps can be specified for a trace that is specified using an encoded polyline.

durations List<int>

List of durations (seconds) between each successive pair of input trace points. This allows trace points to be supplied as an encoded polyline and timestamps to be created by using this list of "delta" times along with the beginTime of the trace.

filters TraceAttributesFilter

The trace attributes filters for this request

Exceptions

ArgumentException

Thrown if neither shape nor encodedPolyline is provided.
